title: The Sheep and the Goats
reflectionText: Neither the sheep nor the goats recognized him. Both asked the same question — when did we see you hungry, a stranger, in prison? The King had been there all along, in the least of them, and the only difference was who had stopped to help. Who have you passed without knowing?
